author: h. k. mckee
title: Baylor equestrian team earns 43 NCEA academic honors for 2026
text:
Baylor University’s equestrian team received recognition on Apr. 8 with a total of 43 selections to the National Collegiate Equestrian Association (NCEA) All-Academic teams and Academic Honor Roll, according to an announcement from the organization.
The recognition includes five Baylor athletes named to the NCEA All-Academic First Team and seven on the Second Team. Additionally, 31 student-athletes were placed on the NCEA Academic Honor Roll.
First-team honorees were required to compete in at least 70 percent of their school’s meets and maintain a cumulative grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.5 while enrolled full-time during both spring and fall semesters. Second-team members needed to participate in a minimum of 60 percent of meets with a GPA of at least 3.25 under similar enrollment conditions.
The Academic Honor Roll was open to student-athletes who earned a cumulative GPA of at least 3.25 while maintaining full-time enrollment during both semesters.
For more information about Baylor Equestrian, updates are available by following @BaylorEQ on X, Instagram, and Facebook.
